email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with mild nausea
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 64-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 20 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-02-13.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter669@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
